overview_description.description:
Vista Global manages a portfolio of private aviation brands and services, providing business aviation solutions to a global clientele. Vista Global Holding provides membership-based private aviation services and aircraft management solutions, positioning itself as an alternative to traditional jet ownership and charter models. 

The company focuses on offering on-demand private jet flights, subscription-based jet access through VistaJet, aircraft leasing and management, and technology-driven aviation solutions. Its portfolio includes several key brands, such as VistaJet, a luxury private jet operator with a floating fleet of Bombardier aircraft, and XO, a digital-first private jet booking platform that provides both charter and membership-based access. Additionally, Vista Global has expanded through acquisitions, including Apollo Jets, a U.S.-based private aviation brokerage acquired in 2021, as well as Jet Edge, a large U.S. charter operator with a fleet of super-midsize and large-cabin jets. In 2022, the company further strengthened its European presence by acquiring Air Hamburg, a German charter operator.

product.name: VistaJet
product.description: A global business aviation service offering aircraft access through membership and program-based flying, with clients paying for flight hours rather than owning an aircraft.

product.name: XO
product.description: A digital private aviation marketplace providing on-demand charter and membership-based access to aircraft without aircraft ownership or long-term commitment.

product.name: Vista Flight Support
product.description: Flight preparation and operational support services covering flight and route planning, permits, fuel, ground arrangements, and trip support for Vista operating partners.

product.name: Global Operator Network
product.description: A network of licensed air carriers and partner operators that provides aircraft and operational capacity for Vista’s global private aviation services.

product.name: Aircraft Maintenance Services
product.description: Aircraft maintenance and engineering support for business jets, delivered through maintenance sites and teams supporting the Vista group fleet and operating partners.
